title.es: El de cuando Fina se confiesa con su padre
title.en: The One Where Fina Confesses to Her Father

description.es: Isidro le pide a Gaspar que le tire de la lengua a Fina, pero Gaspar no lo consigue y le cuenta a Fina lo que pasa. Isidro va a hablar con Fina y le dice que alguien tan maravillosa como ella no merece estar liada con un hombre casado. Sin poder contenerse más, Fina por fin le confiesa a Isidro que está enamorada de una mujer, cosa que Isidro se toma muy mal.
description.en: Isidro asks Gaspar to sound Fina out, but Gaspar cannot manage it and tells Fina what is going on. Isidro goes to talk to Fina and tells her that someone as wonderful as she is does not deserve to be involved with a married man. Unable to hold back any longer, Fina finally confesses to Isidro that she is in love with a woman, and Isidro takes it very badly.
